title: Pixel Art Maker — Free Online Editor
excerpt: Make pixel art online free — draw on a pixel grid with brushes, fill, layers, mirror mode and custom palettes, then export a PNG. No download, no signup, runs in your browser.

SimplePixelArt is a free, browser-based pixel art maker — no installation and no account required. Make pixel art online by drawing directly on a pixel grid with a full set of editor tools, then export a clean PNG. New to it? Start with easy pixel art on a small grid.

Tip

Draw on an empty part of the canvas to spawn a new board, then drag its label to arrange your workspace.

How to use it

  1. Pick a canvas size — open the editor and choose a canvas from 8×8 up to 64×64 pixels.
  2. Draw with the tools — paint with the brush, flood-fill regions, work across layers, and turn on mirror mode for symmetric sprites.
  3. Export & share — export your art as a PNG, or publish it straight to the gallery.

Features

  • Brush & eraser — paint or erase individual pixels with precision; adjustable size for fine detail or broad strokes.
  • Fill tool — flood-fill a region with a single click, ideal for coloring large areas fast.
  • Mirror drawing — horizontal or vertical mirroring to draw symmetric sprites twice as fast.
  • Multiple layers — sketch on one, color on another, stack details on top.
  • Undo / redo — full history; experiment freely and step back through any change.
  • Custom canvas sizes — from 8×8 up to 64×64 pixels, whatever fits your project.
  • Color palette — build and save a palette, then swap colors across the whole canvas instantly.
  • Export & share — publish to the community, or export a PNG for games, web or print.

Frequently asked questions

Tap a question to expand
Is the pixel art editor free?

Yes — completely free and running in your browser. No signup to start and no watermark.

Do I need to install anything?

No. The editor runs in any modern web browser on desktop or mobile — nothing to download.

What canvas sizes can I use?

Anywhere from 8×8 to 64×64 pixels. Smaller canvases suit icons and sprites; larger ones allow more detail.

Can I turn a photo or sprite sheet into pixel art?
How do I export my pixel art?

Export your artwork as a PNG for games, the web or print — and optionally share it to the gallery.

SimplePixelArt 是一款免费的、基于浏览器的像素艺术制作工具 - 无需安装，也无需帐户。 使用全套编辑器工具直接在像素网格上绘图，在线制作像素艺术，然后导出干净的 PNG。 新来的吗？ 从小网格上的简单像素艺术开始。

提示在画布的空白部分上绘制以生成新板，然后拖动其标签来安排工作区。

如何使用

  1. 选择画布尺寸 - 打开编辑器并选择 8×8 到 64×64 像素的画布。
  2. 使用工具进行绘制 - 使用画笔进行绘制、填充区域、跨图层工作以及打开对称精灵的镜像模式。
  3. 导出和共享 — 将您的艺术作品导出为 PNG 格式，或直接发布到画廊。

特征

  • 画笔和橡皮擦——精确地绘制或擦除单个像素；可调整尺寸以获得精细细节或粗笔触。
  • 填充工具 — 只需单击一下即可填充区域，非常适合快速为大面积区域着色。
  • 镜像绘制 - 水平或垂直镜像以两倍的速度绘制对称精灵。
  • 多层——一层上草图，另一层上色，顶部堆叠细节。
  • 撤消/重做——完整历史记录；自由地尝试，并在任何改变中退一步。
  • 自定义画布尺寸 - 从 8×8 到 64×64 像素，无论适合您的项目。
  • 调色板 - 构建并保存调色板，然后立即在整个画布上交换颜色。
  • 导出和共享 — 发布到社区，或导出用于游戏、网络或打印的 PNG。

常见问题

Tap a question to expand
Is the pixel art editor free?

是的 - 完全免费并在您的浏览器中运行。 无需注册即可开始，也没有水印。

Do I need to install anything?

不需要。该编辑器可以在桌面或移动设备上的任何现代网络浏览器中运行 - 无需下载。

What canvas sizes can I use?

从 8×8 到 64×64 像素。 较小的画布适合图标和精灵；较大的可以提供更多细节。

Can I turn a photo or sprite sheet into pixel art?
How do I export my pixel art?

将您的作品导出为适用于游戏、网络或打印的 PNG 格式，并可选择将其分享到画廊。
